name: SALVATION
source:
A short, 20 minute visual novel about an angel trapped within the walls of an abandoned church. His captor, a deranged priest who doesn't tolerate disrespect. Will the angel be able to escape his captivity? 

[From [url=https://braychandler.itch.io/salvation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部20分钟的短篇视觉小说，讲述了一位天使被困在一座废弃教堂的围墙内的故事。他的俘虏是一位精神错乱的牧师，不能容忍不尊重。天使能否逃脱囚禁呢？

[来自[url=https://braychandler.itch.io/salvation]itch.io[/url]]
